rules: Only exact object IDs already in Sacred Phenomena and exact Place IDs in Geography are eligible.
Commons file page author, licence, MIME, dimensions and original checksum are reverified at acquisition time.
Convert source to framelessly presented (no decorative frame added) no-crop WebP; credit photographer and record modifications.
A photo showing a reliquary does not independently authenticate the relic held inside.
Photograph date does not imply current public accessibility, placement, object configuration or recent liturgical practice.
Research/P62 candidates do not become approved by matching keywords; these are explicitly selected exact files.
Do not alter the 1962 Calendar, Place coordinates, relic IDs or original media registries for unrelated Places.
No paid services, no Google Maps scraping, no expiring-only artifact archives.
The modern 2024 Crown reliquary is held for independent underlying artwork-rights review; only an explicitly dated historical Crown photograph is selected for P68.
A missing pinned original SHA1 must be acquired and verified through Commons imageinfo against the downloaded original bytes; never invent a 40-character SHA1 to pass validation.
